name: infrastructure
description: Infrastructure skills: a cloud organization and its accounts planned the same way every time (one organization per company, a billing-only management account, an account per environment, single sign-on, guardrails, a hand-over checklist and a documented fallback region), or checked against that pattern; a step-by-step first-apply guide for any infrastructure-as-code root, with region callouts, cross-environment checks, DNS and secret steps, and a scale-to-zero ('park') drill, if the project has one; and a local reproduction of a failing CI or workflow job, in a throwaway replica of its environment, before anyone changes code on a guess.
